title: 第25章 凝霜之怒第26章 前往内院
content_zh:
沈凝霜听后隐藏在面纱下的美眸冰冷至极，从来没有人能威胁她，除了叶祈安这个家伙威胁过她。
二话不说，沈凝霜那惊人磅礴的元气轰然爆发，席卷整个演武场。
“嘶，好强的元气威压，这威压我怎么感觉比刚才的叶平安还要强呢？”
“说不定会有机会赢？”
叶平安丝毫不担心这场考核，取出腰间的酒壶开始悠闲的喝了起来。
台上。
朱擎苍见状也收起了轻视。
那马仟宇的前车之鉴才刚刚发生，不可大意。
随即他纳戒闪过一阵光芒，一把三尺青峰被他握在手中。
剑意逐渐弥漫在全场，三尺青峰寒光闪过，只见朱擎苍一个箭步冲出，挥出一道剑芒杀向沈凝霜。
“轰隆！”
沈凝霜手中元气凝聚成一头冰晶凤凰，瞬间一股股刺骨的冷冽弥漫，冰晶凤凰俯冲与之剑芒径直碰上！
一道爆炸声音响起。
剑芒层层破碎，而冰晶凤凰夹杂着冷厉刺骨的寒意杀向朱擎苍。
这让现场的众人瞬间寂静了下来。
眼眸中纷纷露出不可置信的表情。
“嘶！这......”
“我没看错吧？这竟然是元气凝型！”径至阁楼中，那青衣男子震惊的说道。
就连坐在最上方的大长老等高层都瞬间弹了起来！
“不到天元境便掌握了元气化型？！”

“这是何等天赋？”大长老眼神中都出现了凝重，这比刚刚叶祈安击败马仟宇来的震撼强多了。
况且看这少女的年纪也就才十八左右。
十八岁掌握元气凝型，这等天赋在天风国还未曾出现过吧？
北凉郡郡主林南拍手叫好说道：“好哈哈，哈哈哈，如此天赋之人竟然在我们北凉郡，真乃天佑我北凉郡！”
而林霸天的眼神中更是充满着狂热贪婪，这个绝世美人他要定了！
凭借他爹是北凉郡主，他有这个自信。
台下，冰晶凤凰轻松就将对方的剑意化解并全程压制着朱擎苍打！
这让不可一世的朱擎苍感到无比的憋屈，同时心中的震惊无以复加。
眼前的白裙女子太恐怖，比他掌握了入门剑意还要恐怖。
元气雄厚的犹如绵绵不绝的大江，并且元气极其凌厉刺骨。
朱擎苍身影被击退数十米，这才堪堪稳住身影。
手持三尺青峰一脸凝重的看着沈凝霜。
“没想到你才是这次考核的最大黑马，不到十八岁就掌握了元气化型。”
“我承认你的天赋很强，但是...我可是半步天元！”
沈凝霜早就看出了他真实修为其实是半步天元境，平静的说道。
“出手吧，不出手，你就没机会了。”
content_en:
After hearing this, Shen Ningshuang's beautiful eyes hidden under the veil were extremely cold. No one had ever been able to threaten her, except for Ye Qian, who had threatened her.
Without saying a word, Shen Ningshuang's astonishing and majestic vitality exploded, sweeping across the entire martial arts arena.
"Hiss, what a strong pressure of vitality. Why do I feel that this pressure is stronger than Ye Pingan just now?"
"Maybe there's a chance to win?"
Ye Pingan was not worried about this assessment at all. He took out the wine bottle from his waist and started drinking leisurely.
On stage.
When Zhu Qingcang saw this, he also put away his contempt.
Ma Qianyu's lesson has just happened, so don't be careless.
Then his Najie flashed with light, and a three-foot green peak was held in his hand.
The sword intent gradually filled the whole place, and the cold light of the three-foot green peak flashed, and Zhu Qingcang rushed out with an arrow step and swung a sword light towards Shen Ningshuang.
"Boom!"
The vitality in Shen Ningshuang's hand condensed into an ice crystal phoenix, and instantly a biting coldness filled the air. The ice crystal phoenix dived and met its sword light directly!
An explosion sounded.
The sword light was shattered layer by layer, and the ice crystal phoenix was killing Zhu Qingcang with a biting coldness.
This caused everyone at the scene to fall silent for an instant.
There were expressions of disbelief in their eyes.
"Hiss! This..."
"Am I right? This is actually a vitality condensed form!" Walking into the attic, the man in green said in shock.
Even the great elder and other senior officials sitting at the top jumped up instantly!
"You have mastered the form of vitality before reaching the Tianyuan realm?!"
"What kind of talent is this?" The great elder's eyes showed solemnity. This was much more shocking than when Ye Qian'an defeated Ma Qianyu just now.
Besides, this girl is only about eighteen years old.
Mastering Yuan Qi Condensation at the age of eighteen. Such a talent has never appeared in Tianfeng Kingdom, right?
Lin Nan, the princess of Beiliang County, clapped her hands and applauded and said: "Hahaha, hahaha, such a talented person is actually in our Beiliang County. God has blessed our Beiliang County!"
And Lin Batian's eyes were full of fanaticism and greed. He wanted to bet on this peerless beauty!
He has this confidence because his father is the princess of Beiliang County.
In the audience, the Ice Crystal Phoenix easily neutralized the opponent's sword intent and suppressed Zhu Qingcang throughout the fight!
This made the arrogant Zhu Qingcang feel extremely aggrieved, and at the same time, he was extremely shocked.
The woman in the white dress in front of him was too terrifying, even more terrifying than if he had mastered the Sword Intent.
The vitality is as strong as an endless river, and the vitality is extremely sharp and bone-piercing.
Zhu Qingcang's figure was pushed back dozens of meters before he could stabilize his figure.
Holding a three-foot green peak, he looked at Shen Ningshuang solemnly.
"I didn't expect you to be the biggest dark horse in this assessment. You mastered the vitality transformation type before you were eighteen years old."
"I admit that your talent is very strong, but...I am only half-step Tianyuan!"
Shen Ningshuang had long seen that his true cultivation level was actually half-step Tianyuan realm, and said calmly.
"Take action. If you don't, you will have no chance."
